body.name: Few-two-parent residual-algebra handle
body.construction: Expose the at most \(2K_G\) coefficients entering the two-parent vertices, condition on their values, normalize every remaining fan-in-one component by \(\mathrm{def:mobius\mbox{-}sat\mbox{-}handle}\), and encode the unsimplified interactions as a semialgebraic constraint problem over those exposed coefficients and the equality atoms of \(\Psi\).
